readout_other: multielectrode array LFP recording (peak amplitude and latency)
direction_notes: Ultrasound evoked LFP responses in cortical slices whose peak amplitudes increased with pressure and whose duration scaled with stimulus duration; TTX reduced or abolished them.

exposures.label: CW ultrasound to mouse auditory cortex slice via waveguide

target.label: brain slices that included the auditory cortex

timing.protocol_description: Continuous-wave 500 kHz stimulus of 100 or 200 ms at four pressures (110-410 kPa), delivered through a 3D-printed waveguide below the MEA. Each stimulation block consisted of 20 trials with a 5 s interval, alternating with current stimulation blocks.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Overall, we obtained 351 ultrasound-evoked responses and 1,069 current-evoked responses for seven brain slices obtained from five animals.
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: For the CW, the original rectangular wave with a fundamental frequency of 500 kHz was generated by a function generator (WF1947, NF Co., Yokohama, Japan).
source_quotes.exposures[0].unspecified_domain.pressure: The acoustic pressure was varied from 110 to 410 kPa in 100 kPa steps: i.e., 110, 210, 310, and 410 kPa, and the corresponding power integral intensity (spatial peak pulse average, $I _ { \mathrm { s p p a } }$ in Eq. 5) was 0.41, 1.49, 3.24, and 5.68 $\mathrm { W } / { \mathrm { c m } } ^ { 2 }$ , respectively.
source_quotes.exposures[0].unspecified_domain.isppa_w_: The acoustic pressure was varied from 110 to 410 kPa in 100 kPa steps: i.e., 110, 210, 310, and 410 kPa, and the corresponding power integral intensity (spatial peak pulse average, $I _ { \mathrm { s p p a } }$ in Eq. 5) was 0.41, 1.49, 3.24, and 5.68 $\mathrm { W } / { \mathrm { c m } } ^ { 2 }$ , respectively.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.sonication_duration_: the CW stimuli had a duration of100 or 200 ms.
source_quotes.exposures[0].device.manufacturer: we conducted ultrasound irradiation using a transducer (V301-SU, Olympus, Waltham, MA, United States)
source_quotes.exposures[0].device.model: we conducted ultrasound irradiation using a transducer (V301-SU, Olympus, Waltham, MA, United States)

flags.reason: Seven slices from five mice; n_subjects is the number of slices (preparations).
Pressures given as the stimulation pressure setting; the dish/bath has no skull; domain not stated so recorded as unspecified. Simulation text also uses 100 kPa at the transducer surface.
Intensities 0.41, 1.49, 3.24 and 5.68 W/cm2 are stated to correspond to the four pressures (Isppa from Eq. 5).
Continuous-wave tone of 100 or 200 ms, with blocks of 20 trials at 5 s intervals; the paper calls it a CW with a fixed window length.
